components.css: .ds-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d7d9cf);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif}.ds-tabs button{font:inherit;color:var(--muted,#59665c);background:none;border:0;text-align:left;padding:18px 20px;min-height:82px;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs b{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;display:block}.ds-tabs b span{font-size:13px;font-weight:400;margin-left:8px}.ds-tabs small{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--muted,#59665c)}.ds-tabs [aria-selected=true]{border-color:var(--rust,#994222);background:var(--warm,#eee0cd);color:var(--ink,#233e34)}.ds-tabs button:hover{background:#eee9de}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--rust,#994222);outline-offset:5px}

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-around;height:63px;padding:0 10px;background:var(--paper,#f7f4ed);color:var(--ink,#233e34);border-top:1px solid var(--line,#d7d9cf);box-shadow:0 -4px 20px rgba(35,62,52,.06);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif}.ds-nav a{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;min-width:65px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav svg{width:21px;height:21px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav .ds-active{color:var(--rust,#994222);box-shadow:inset 0 2px var(--rust,#994222)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--rust,#994222);outline-offset:5px}

narrative.overview: This phrase is taken from the implemented wordmark, rather than a separately selected aesthetic concept. Warm ivory, forest ink and rust support a relaxed travel guide. Fraunces headings, licensed destination photographs and generous section spacing provide its editorial character; transport times and controls use system sans-serif typography.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper with forest text and restrained rust emphasis.
Real destination photography, with credits and seasonal context.
Simple route geometry, readable times and clear uncertainty labels.
Mobile bottom navigation, keyboard day tabs and saved packing ticks.
dos: **Do** retain the warm ivory, forest ink and rust direction.
**Do** preserve visible keyboard focus and text labels for status.
**Do** keep route geometry simple and label it as a schematic.
**Do** retain photo credits and distinguish destination imagery from current conditions.
donts: **Don't** imply that proposed transport or an unconfirmed shuttle is booked.
**Don't** communicate packing completion or itinerary status through color alone.
**Don't** replace the mobile bottom navigation or hide all days when JavaScript is unavailable.
